DoorDash is building the world's most reliable on-demand, logistics engine for delivery! We're looking for experienced engineers to join our fast-growing engineering team to help us develop a critical financial data platform that supports DoorDash’s financial products and ecosystem

About the Role

Money team engineers solve key business and financial problems with elegant technical solutions. You'll operate our financial backend services and architecture that support all business and will be challenged to consider the big picture -- collaborating cross-functionally, as well as evaluating and executing on trade-offs to maximize business impact for the company. You will be part of a team to drive the evolution of the system to be a world-class big data platform with top notch reliability, scalability, usability, and data quality.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Develop, release and run large-scale data systems
  • Develop and define the backend architecture and tech stack for the financial and accounting needs
  • Improve performance, reliability, scalability and security for our financial data platform

We're excited about you because you have...

  • B.S., M.S., or PhD. in Computer Science or equivalent
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • Prior experience working with backend tech stacks
  • **Interviews will be conducted in English**

Nice To Haves

  • Experience with big data or large scale database systems
  • Experiences with financial or accounting software
  • Experience with Java/Kotlin

Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only

We use Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provide Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023, and resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024.

The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here: Covey

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, CloudKitchens - São Paulo
description:
Who we are

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone.

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

What you’ll do

  • Develop clean, efficient, and maintainable code to implement integrations
  • Provide ongoing maintenance, support, and enhancements to existing systems and platforms
  • Design, develop, and maintain APIs that enable seamless communication between internal and external services.
  • Design scalable, reliable, fault-tolerant architectural systems
  • Collaborate and prioritize with cross functional stakeholders, both internal and external

What we’re looking for

  • 6+ years of proven domain experience as a software engineer.
  • Conversational English, since you’ll be reporting and communicating with global teams in your day-to-day work.
  • Working knowledge of highly distributed systems.
  • Collaborate with leaders to create a center of engineering excellence for Global Integrations and Brazil Engineering.
  • Help teams establish technical understanding and trust needed to succeed and execute on ambitious goals in Integrations
  • Mentor and develop team members on technical and non-technical skills to create a high functioning team

Why join us
 Growing market: You’ll be focused on an $80 billion market that’s projected to reach at least $500 billion by 2030 in the US alone.Changing the restaurant industry: You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.

What else you need to know
 This role is based in our Sao Paulo location. We believe that people do their best work when they are together. As a company, we’re in the marketplace of ideas and innovation. When you’re constantly innovating, changing how an industry works, inventing new products and processes - and we are doing all these things - we believe we’re better as a team in-person. That’s why all of our teams (except for our field-based roles) are now working from one of our office locations 5 days a week. Looking forward to sharing more about a Career of Substance at Cloudkitchens.

Ready to join us as we serve those who serve others?

title: LÍDER DE FRIOS - VILA MATHIAS
description:
Job description

Liderar a equipe de trabalho no setor de Perecíveis, definir as necessidades de abastecimento das áreas conforme a demanda, cumprir e disseminar as normas e regras da companhia.


Main responsibilities

• Liderar o setor de perecíveis, acompanhar e identificar as prioridades para reabastecimento de produtos, requisitar a separação de produtos em estoque, acompanhar o abastecimento dos produtos observando se estão limpos, sem avarias, dentro da data de validade e averiguar se foram alocados corretamente no ponto de venda, evitando a ocorrência de rupturas no setor.

• Acompanhar o recebimento de produtos do FLV, verificar a qualidade dos produtos recebidos, acompanhar a contagem e requisitar o envio dos produtos para as gondolas e ilhas .

• Acompanhar assiduamente o prazo de validade dos produtos expostos no ponto de venda, verificar todas as ilhas de FLV, geladeiras e gondolas, observando a ocorrência de produtos em mau estado de conservação e que já não podem ser comercializados e retirá-los e encaminhá-los para o setor de avarias. Na identificação de avarias em outros locais solicitar o envio da mercadoria para o setor de avarias.

• Acompanhar os níveis de estoque, checar diariamente se os níveis de produtos em estoque estão de acordo com as necessidades da loja.

• Observar e solicitar, quando necessário, a entrega de produtos que tem maior venda na loja.

• Acionar a gerencia da loja quando observado elevados níveis de estoque de determinado produto, sugerir ações de promoção destes produtos.

• Anteriormente a abertura da loja verificar a ocorrência de falta de colaboradores, compor a equipe de trabalho, alocando os colaboradores em seus devidos postos de trabalho, fazer reunião diária para repasse de informações e diretrizes do setor e empresa.

• Verificar a ocorrência de avarias, rupturas, mudança de preço e necessidades de abastecimento, checar o funcionamento dos balcões refrigerados, freezers, câmara fria e carrinho hidráulico utilizados no setor, e providenciar as devidas ações para garantir os processos de abastecimento, organização e limpeza do setor.

• Elaborar escalas de trabalhos, distribuir os colaboradores de acordo com as prioridades de trabalho e comunicá-los sobre a escala.

• Acompanhar o registro de ponto da equipe, observando faltas, atrasos e necessidades de abonos.

• Acompanhar o desempenho e medir a produtividade individual de cada colaborador, instruir sobre os procedimentos da empresa e orientar para a melhoria do desempenho. Quando necessário, aplica sanções disciplinares nos colaboradores.

• Atender clientes para dirimir duvidas gerais de produtos, atender ligações especificas do Televendas para informar quantidades de produto em estoque.

• Acompanhar as atividades dos promotores (de fornecedores), verificar a identificação do promotor, orientar quanto aos procedimentos da loja, dirigir o promotor para o local em que desenvolverá as atividades e observar a o desenvolvimento das ações.

• Coordenar a montagem de ilhas de promoção, orientando sobre o melhor ponto de montagem e layout da ilha.


Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio Completo;

Interbrand understands what it takes today to build the world’s most iconic brands.

Sales Trader de Renda Variável (Curitiba)

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório deagentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grandeecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra,determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente:Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande:Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta:Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor:Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

O nosso propósito é transformar o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Começamos em 2001, como um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de pessoas talentosas que, por meio da nossa cultura de Sonho Grande, Mente Aberta e Espírito Empreendedor, tiveram a autonomia e liberdade que precisavam para transformar o mercado financeiro.

Porém, sabemos que o desafio é muito maior. Os grandes bancos ainda possuem 95% do mercado de investimentos no Brasil, mas estamos aqui para romper essa lógica e melhorar a vida de muito mais pessoas. Somos exatamente o que o sistema financeiro nunca foi.

Se você se identifica com esses conceitos e deseja construir algo especial, mergulhe de cabeça nesta oportunidade.

Sobre a oportunidade

Como Sales Trader, você irá atuar auxiliando nossos clientes mais relevantes nas tomadas de decisão no universo da renda variável, levando em consideração o momento de mercado, a visão do nosso time de research e o perfil de cada investidor. Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

  • Transmitir recomendações de operações de curto, médio e longo prazo, de acordo com o perfil do cliente;
  • Execução de operações nos mercados à vista, futuro e a termo;
  • Assessoria na montagem de operações estruturadas;
  • Contato ativo com os maiores clientes de renda variável da XP para acompanhamento de posição e atualização de cenário de mercado; (alternativa: contato ativo com clientes que possuam carteira de ações acima de R$ 300 mil)
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes e assessores no universo de renda variável.

// O que buscamos

  • Estar habituado em colocar o cliente no centro de nossas decisões;
  • Curiosidade em Renda Variável;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo 100% presencial em Curitiba;

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência prévia em mesa de operações;
  • Certificação CPA-20.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
About Digibee
Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

We are looking for a highly skilled FP&A analyst to join our team. As a senior FP&A Analyst, you will play a critical role in managing financial planning and analysis activities, providing insights to senior management, and supporting investor relations efforts. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, financial modeling expertise, and excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders effectively.
We offer a dynamic, fast-paced environment with high-level exposure to different initiatives and projects.

On a typical day, you will…

  1. Review the monthly financial statement.
  2. Interact with the investors, being responsible for dealing with their ad hoc analysis.
  3. Conduct financial modeling and scenario analysis to evaluate strategic initiatives, investment opportunities, and business performance metrics.
  4. Develop and enhance financial measurement reporting tools.
  5. Prepare and coordinate internal and monthly reports.
  6. Prepare ad hoc analysis to support strategic decision-making.
  7. Measure and analyze the KPIs, interact with other departments to understand the current scenario, and provide this view.
  8. Prepare financial viability analysis of new investments.
  9. Lead the development of financial forecasts, budgets, and long-range plans in collaboration with functional teams.
  10. Perform variance analysis to assess financial performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods, identifying key drivers and trends for P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash-Flow.
  11. Prepare insightful financial presentations and reports for senior management and the board of directors, highlighting key performance metrics, risks, and opportunities.
  12. Support investor relations activities, including preparation of quarterly earnings materials, investor presentations, and responding to inquiries from analysts and investors.
  13. Drive process improvements and efficiencies in financial planning and analysis processes, leveraging technology and automation tools where appropriate.
  14. Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory developments to inform financial analysis and decision-making.

What You'll Need To Bring

  1. Bachelors in business administration, engineering, economics, accounting or similar.
  2. 5+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, investment banking, or related roles.
  3. Knowledge of the main Financial Statements: Balance sheets, P&L and Cash Flow.
  4. Experience in Financial Modeling.
  5. Fluency in English.
  6. Advanced Excel skills.
  7. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with ability to distill complex financial concepts into clear and concise messages for diverse audiences.
  8. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
  9. Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

What is nice to have

  1. Experience in SaaS Industry.
  2. VBA preferred.
  3. SQL / Python.
  4. Experience with investor relations (preferred).

Our perks and benefits

  1. We're remote first, with a flexible working schedule.
  2. Health care and Odonto Plan.
  3. R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food and meal allowance, mobility, home office supplies, culture, health, and education).
  4. Life insurance.
  5. Child care assistance.
  6. Gympass.
  7. English course: we have a partnership for group classes for R$100 monthly.

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

Are you excited about working at the forefront of applied research in an industry setting? Thomson Reuters Labs in São Paulo is seeking scientists with a passion for solving problems using state-of-the-art information retrieval, natural language processing, and generative AI.

What does Thomson Reuters Labs do?

We experiment, build, and deliver. We support the organization and our customers through applied research in informational retrieval and natural language processing. We work closely with product and domain experts to identify compelling solutions at the intersection of user need and technical feasibility. Our team is designing the next generation of search technology for Legal and Tax Professionals globally. We drive AI innovation for Thomson Reuters.

About the Role

Lead Applied Scientists are experts in Machine Learning / NLP, responsible for designing and delivering AI solutions that enhance Thomson Reuters' products. They leverage information retrieval techniques, prompting workflows, model training, and evaluation design to build and optimize solutions. Their work ensures AI technologies are effectively aligned with business objectives, driving product innovation and value.

As a Lead Applied Scientist, you will:

  1. Innovate and drive solution delivery as a technical leader
  2. Be fully accountable for all research deliverables

  4. Lead and drive stakeholder engagement with other functions (UX, Product, Tech)
  5. Develop in-depth knowledge of customer problems and data
  6. Maintain scientific and technical expertise in one or more relevant areas as demonstrated through product deliverables, published research, and intellectual property
  7. Mentor and coach other scientists and engineers on best practices

About You

You’re a fit for the role of Lead Applied Scientist if your background includes:

  1. PhD in a relevant discipline or Master’s plus a comparable level of experience
  2. 7+ years hands-on experience building IR / NLP systems for commercial applications
  3. Experience writing production code and ensuring well-managed software delivery
  4. Advanced English
  5. Demonstrable experience translating complex problems into successful AI applications
  6. Professional experience scaling yourself and leading through others, in an applied research setting
  7. Outstanding communication, problem solving, and analysis skills
  8. Collaborating with Product, Engineering and Business Stakeholders in an agile manner to demonstrate value and iterate with customer feedback

Essas políticas se baseiam em nossa abordagem flexível de trabalho, permitindo que os funcionários trabalhem de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano, promovendo assim um equilíbrio ideal entre seus compromissos de trabalho e pessoais.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: Promovemos uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, preparando nossos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do futuro e oferecer soluções reais. Nosso programa "Grow My Way" e a abordagem focada em habilidades garantem que você tenha as ferramentas e conhecimentos para crescer, liderar e prosperar em um futuro habilitado pela inteligência artificial.

  • Cultura: Reconhecida globalmente por inclusão e pertencimento, flexibilidade, equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Vivemos nossos valores: obsessão pelos nossos clientes, competir para ganhar, desafiar o (seu) nosso pensamento, agir rápido e aprender rápido e juntos somos mais fortes.

TechnipFMC is committed to driving real change in the energy industry. Our ambition is to build a sustainable future through relentless innovation and global collaboration – and we want you to be part of it. You’ll be joining a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and ideas as well as diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 20,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go.

Job Purpose

About Us: At TechnipFMC, within the Controls & Automation product line, we are pioneering technology platforms for the electrification of Subsea Control Systems and the advancement of renewable energy sources such as offshore wind, hydrogen, and wave energy.

Our Team : The Electronics R&D team works across a broad spectrum of technologies, including analog electronics, FPGA, SoC, power design, safety design, motor controllers, processor design, and power line modems. These technologies are integral to various control system applications.

Your Role: As part of the Controls & Automation team at TechnipFMC, you will engage in the design, development, qualification, system integration, and production of new products into commissioning and field operation. Our multidisciplinary development environment includes HW, SW, system, test, mechatronics, and production engineering teams working collaboratively.

We are seeking Senior Embedded Hardware Developers with expertise in embedded systems and hardware design to join our Hardware development team.

Job Description

  • Define hardware requirements in collaboration with system architects, SW architects, product owners
  • Design and develop embedded hardware circuits, PCBAs, FPGA modules, including component selection, schematic drawing, PCB layout, and prototype building.
  • Conduct functional verification of embedded hardware circuits, PCBAs, FPGA modules, electronic sub-assemblies.
  • Collaborate with systems architects, mechanical designers, PCB layout, manufacturing, reliability, and SW engineering teams to design and develop embedded hardware products.
  • Create test and verification procedures and write test reports on functional, environmental, system operation mode, and manufacturing testing of custom embedded hardware designs.

You are meant for this job if:

  • Extended understanding of Central Processing Units, microcontrollers, embedded software and signal processing techniques
  • Advanced knowledge of VHDL and FPGA design and verification methodologies.
  • Experience of LT SPICE, MATLAB, Simulink, Python, and Intel (Altera) Quartus
  • Knowledge of C, C++, assembly language or other embedded software languages
  • Schematic design and PCB layout using ECAD tools like Altium Designer or equivalent.
  • Experience with lab instruments such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, network analyzers, communication analyzers, signal generators, and simulators.
  • Expertise in PCB layout for optimal component placement, reduced stray inductance/capacitance, improved manufacturability, and EMC compliance.
  • Experience in embedded hardware design optimized for DFX requirements (manufacturability and testability).
  • Understanding of EMC requirements and CE certification relevant to embedded controller design in control system applications.
  • Knowledge and experience of safety and reliability standards including IEC61508

Qualifications:

  • BSc, MSc, or PhD in electronics, automation, cybernetics, or a related engineering field.
  • 3-5 years of industrial experience in relevant embedded hardware development and industrialization.
  • Ability to approach complex problems structurally.
  • Open-minded, professional English proficiency, and adaptability to work in a multicultural environment.
  • Continuously raising standards, innovative, and solution oriented.
  • Interest in electronics is an additional advantage.

What We Offer:

  • Engaging tasks and work-life balance.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Comprehensive insurance and pension plans.

Skills

We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture.

Senior P&E Solution Architect - SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing and SAP Integrated Business Planning

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choosefrom.

PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES

SAP Digital Manufacturing is a critical mission application for our customers who produce anything from food to electronics, medical instruments or automotive parts. Our cloud service must be extremely reliable and run our customers’ shop floor operations with high performance in discrete and process manufacturing industries around the world.

SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) is used by more than 1000 customers globally across 24 industries as the primary supply chain planning application. Key business processes supported include Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, Sales and Operations Planning, along with others.

As a Product &Engineering Solution Architect who is part of our SAP S/4HANA Product Experience - Cloud ERP Product Success team, you will transform our market and accelerate our momentum for our Cloud products.

Our team is responsible for the execution of our strategy, scope and the product experience for SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing. We focus on unlocking the right capabilities of our digital core with the needed focus to scale the business.

You will have impact and contact by bridging between our customer demand, our sales priorities and our product definition and development units. Customer adoption for SCM SAP Digital Manufacturing and SAP IBP with the rollout of new functionality will be an important part of your daily role.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will collaborate with our customers, Implementation Partners, Field Sales, Field Services, Product Teams, Support Teams, and Development Teams across SAP to:

  • Keep track of your customer engagements and work with Customers and Services to assess and prioritize requests during the implementation of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution and SAP IBP in the Americas Region, focusing on the Latin America countries.
  • Increase the success of SAP’s market-leading cloud-based manufacturing solution by providing powerful automation capabilities easy to configure, deploy and monitor across different manufacturing sites.
  • You will be working with your empowered product team to discover and deliver delighting innovations based on opportunities and problems to be solved , defined by the overall product vision and strategy. With a data-driven approach you can manage, and increment features delivered to drive adoption within the customer base.
  • Manage (understand, analyze and categorize) individual customer demand for the of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution and SAP IBP in a regional setup , assuring one face to the customer from Product Success and Product Experience.
  • Work with Product and Development teams to compile SAP’s product roadmap based on customer feedback.
  • Be the voice of the product for Customers, Sales and Presales by advocating solution readiness and innovations to drive adoption of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution and SAP IBP.
  • Prepare and conduct expert testing on planned and future functionality of SAP Digital Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution along with cross-functional products that will deliver the SAP Intelligent Enterprise Suite.

Your impact and support of our deliverables on the strategy of our innovations will be key via:

  • Experience in working with clients in analyzing and transferring market and client demand directly into the Product Management/Development teams (functional specification, co-innovation, etc.).
  • Excellent ability to liaise with the different internal organizations (Development, Preferred success organization, Customer first organization, Field, etc.), becoming a key counterpart for stakeholders in Product Management / Development organization.
  • Outstanding project management skills to align with the respective areas and drive projects successfully along tight deadlines.

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS/ SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science or Business Administration (Engineering) or comparable education required.
  • Relevant experience in software innovation projects, product management, support and customer facing roles (e.g. Functional consultant, solution architect, support, presales).
  • Strong experience in professional software development. Relevant working experience in the SAP environment.
  • Domain knowledge in manufacturing, planning , and/or logistics combined with strong analytical skills and technical expertise of SAP BTP based cloud solutions.
  • Domain knowledge in supply chain planning processes
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders from cross functional teams in multiple regions/time zones.
  • Ability to distill technical information fast and prepare stakeholder specific content out of it, with the business outcome in mind and customer focus; ability to simplify complex information.
  • Experience in product definition (ideally close to a Product Owner role), alternatively: Proven track record in or on collaboration with Product Development and/or Product Management and/or Solution Management
  • Excellent communication and language skills in Portuguese, Spanish and English (spoken and written)
  • Strong interpersonal , coordination, communication and presentation skills.

Preferred skills

  • Deep understanding of the Cloud architecture and SaaS model.
  • Experience as a Subject Matter Expert in a functional area like Logistics or Manufacturing is a plus.
  • MBA or master’s degree in related field is desired.
  • Design thinking expertise welcome but not mandatory.
  • Good knowledge of Cloud principles
  • Activate Methodology is a plus
  • ERP Business Processes Knowledge
  • Experience in co-innovation processes would be a plus

The Manufacturing Dispatching & Execution team empowers manufacturers with the tools necessary to produce high-quality products consistently, comply with regulatory requirements, achieve operational transparency, ensure full traceability of materials and processes, and support sustainable practices. This holistic approach not only enhances operational efficiency but also builds customer trust and satisfaction across the board.

SAP IBP brings core supply chain planning processes into a common platform, allowing for consistency in data, collaboration between teams, and seamless integration to ERP. Benefits of IBP include: reduced inventory investments, improved customer service levels, reduced operational costs, and improved collaboration both internally and with the customer’s suppliers and customers.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. description:
As UPAs - Unidades de Pronto Atendimento são definidas como estabelecimentos de saúde de complexidade intermediária entre as Unidades Básicas de Saúde/Estratégia Saúde da Família (UBS/ESF) e a Rede Hospitalar, devendo compor, junto com estas, uma rede organizada de atenção às urgências, em conformidade com as diretrizes da Política Nacional de Atenção às Urgências.

As UPAs funcionam 24 horas e prestam atendimento médico de urgência e emergência, adulto e pediátrico, com a possibilidade de inserção de outras especialidades médicas como Ortopedia conforme a necessidade da região.

O atendimento é feito a partir do Acolhimento com Classificação de Risco, que estabelece as prioridades de tempo para o atendimento médico conforme a gravidade do paciente. Além disso, o serviço oferece leitos para observação, realização de procedimentos como exames laboratoriais de urgência, exames de imagem, suturas, inalação, administração de medicamentos e, caso necessário, encaminha os pacientes de maior gravidade, após estabilização, ao Hospital de Referência.

MÉDICO CIRURGIÃO VASCULAR - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, distribuídos entre emergência, unidades de terapia intensiva (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal, maternidade, clínica médica, cirurgia geral, bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos na Zona Oeste, região atendida pelo hospital, há duas enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial, dispondo de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções graves em pacientes com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, com 39 leitos, que absorve demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII livre para casos de risco de morte, cirurgias urgentes e internações. Este CER possui atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prestar atendimento nas enfermarias, centro cirúrgico e Unidade de Terapia Intensiva do Hospital Municipal Pedro II.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Medicina.
  • Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista na área.
  • Registro ativo no conselho de classe.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 (seis) meses comprovada na função.

O hospital está localizado em Santa Cruz - RJ. A carga horária varia entre 10h, 12h e 24h semanais, dependendo da vaga.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores ou prestadores de serviço, com vínculo de parentesco ou atuação em diferentes modalidades contratuais, devem consultar as normativas de RH vigentes junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma entidade civil sem fins lucrativos, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, atuando em vários níveis na gestão de serviços e organizações de saúde, com foco na promoção da saúde e na prevenção de doenças, atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

A organização busca expandir suas ações na área social e educacional, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade social, econômica e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, instituições afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são geridas por profissionais altamente capacitados, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do SUS, garantindo acesso universal e de qualidade à saúde, apoiada por equipes multiprofissionais qualificadas.

O PAIS , iniciado em 2001 em São Paulo, estende-se a outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e a qualidade de vida, pautado nos princípios de integralidade e equidade, com gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM promove oportunidades de trabalho para pessoas com deficiência, com planos de carreira e anúncios periódicos divulgados nos principais jornais das regiões onde atua.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, garantindo atendimento de qualidade em todos os níveis de assistência para a população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Description

Provide knowledge, leadership, insight and direction for broking activities to ensure that clients’ expectations are regularly met. This role incorporates a wide level of expertise, but always assumes the broker is capable of handling accounts independently. The size and complexity of the account can vary. More experienced brokers may be responsible for training and supervising Associate Brokers. Responsible to ensure that relevant regulatory and technical standards are met. Helps drive the broking team to achieve agreed operational and financial goals and objectives.

Note that visa employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity

The Role

  • Orchestrate new business placement, renewals and alterations of existing coverage.
  • Develop, review and deliver presentations to secure new, and build on existing, relationships.
  • Review and evaluate information and analytics to assess and evaluate client risks to support the placement of client risks in the market.
  • Research and evaluate all solutions (insurance and otherwise) to identify and develop optimum risk solutions for clients.
  • Provide coverage and program design advice and expertise to client; perform needs and gap analysis to make recommendations regarding program improvements.
  • Build strong partnerships with a broad range of organizations and stakeholders in the market in order to secure optimum terms and conditions for clients.
  • Contribute to thought leadership and continuous process improvement of the Broking function.
  • Work closely with associates to stay on top of changes in the marketplace.
  • Oversee design and preparation of draft proposals; negotiate and finalize of carrier quotes, terms and conditions and coverage confirmations to ensure contract certainty.
  • Bind carrier quotes and review binders and coverage confirmations.
  • Request / Attend and participate in regular client and underwriter meetings.
  • Conduct program peer reviews.
  • Provide coaching to brokers in training.

Qualifications

The Requirements
• 5-12 years industry experience (real estate, hospitality and leisure industry experience preferred but not required)
• Insurance broker’s P&C license required
• Strong group presentation skills (written and verbal); ability to drive complex/technical conversations
• Relationship management: customer focus, collaboration, interpersonal skills, and conflict management; demonstrates shared ownership of resolution of conflicts
• Negotiation skills: carrier and client negotiation skills; can secure concessions without damaging relationships
• Business acumen: demonstrates knowledge of industries and clients, carriers, and/or markets
• Project management: ability to effectively manage and oversee small projects
• Receptive to feedback; critical thinking and problem-solving skills; high adaptability
• Leadership skills: applies judgment in making decisions, directs and motivates others, takes lead in small groups, and promotes teamwork
This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

Compensation and Benefits
Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation (Producer roles only).


Compensation
The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $150,000 - $175,000 USD per year.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (only included for Washington roles)
  • Retirement Benefits: Qualified contributory pension plan (if eligible) and 401(k) plan with annual nonelective company contribution. Non-qualified retirement plans available to senior level colleagues who satisfy the plans’ eligibility requirements.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

At WTW, we trust you to know your work and the people, tools and environment you need to be successful. The majority of our colleagues work in a ”hybrid” style, with a mix of remote, in-person and in-office interactions dependent on the needs of the team, role and clients. Our flexibility is rooted in trust and “hybrid” is not a one-size-fits-all solution.

Nossos valores

  • Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos, com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

Sobre a oportunidade

Esta rede é direcionada a pessoas plenas e sêniores que buscam atuar como Investor na XP Inc na região de Curitiba . Temos vagas previstas para serem abertas em 2024 com diversas senioridades na estrutura. Caso seu perfil faça sentido para alguma destas vagas , entraremos em contato, convidando para avançar no processo seletivo.

Como Investor do time de Estratégia XP , você ficará responsável por trabalhar o asset allocation dos clientes de forma sofisticada, garantindo o enquadramento dos portfólios, de acordo com o suitability de cada cliente.

O Investor ocupa a posição de referência técnica para o segmento e, além de garantir a qualidade na alocação dos clientes, atua sendo interface direta com as áreas de negócio da companhia, pensando estrategicamente quais ativos devem ser trabalhados e quais perfis de cliente têm maior propensão para determinada oferta. Geram insumos comerciais para todo o time, através de treinamentos, dados, materiais, etc.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Atender os principais clientes da XP, em conjunto com o Banker do cliente;
  • Ser referência técnica sobre produtos, planejamento financeiro e asset allocation no segmento;
  • Identificar as melhores oportunidades de investimentos, garantindo assertividade comercial;
  • Construir e disseminar as melhores práticas de investimentos entre os assessores;
  • Realizar consultoria de investimentos para garantir excelência no atendimento e monitorar os indicadores de qualidade;
  • Atuar no nível tático e estratégico junto às áreas que impactam direta e indiretamente o cliente final.

Pré-requisitos

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Sólido conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RV, RF, Fundos, Previdência, entre outros);
  • Conhecimento sobre asset allocation, enquadramento, inteligência de base;
  • Conhecimentos de macroeconomia e sua conjuntura atual;
  • Experiência atendendo clientes Private ou Alta Renda;
  • CFP ou CGA ou CFG;

Diferenciais

  • CFA ou outras certificações.

Modelo De Trabalho

  • Presencial em Curitiba e proximidades.

Benefícios Que Oferecemos

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

At DoorDash, we’re on a mission to empower local economies — and that mission drives everything we do. We’re building the future of local commerce, and we’re looking for team members excited to be part of that journey.

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. We value creativity, ownership, and continuous learning — and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone can grow their careers while making a real difference.

We also care deeply about our team’s well-being. DoorDash offers comprehensive benefits, including premium healthcare, paid parental leave, wellness reimbursements, and more — because we believe that when our people thrive, our communities thrive too.

About the Team

DoorDash is looking for Full Stack Engineers to join our Trust & Safety team. This dedicated group is entrusted with empowering both external DoorDash customers and internal users through a comprehensive catalog of Trust and Safety features, focusing on authenticity, eligibility, compliance, and beyond.

As a Full Stack Engineer, you will collaborate closely with other high caliber engineers within an international team and cross-functional stakeholders to propel the group forward. Leveraging latest technological advancements, including Gen AI, you will build best-in-class Trust and Safety experience on one of the largest gig platforms in the world.

Fullstack Engineers at DoorDash help design and build beautiful, intuitive user interfaces for our web applications as well as elegant backend APIs and services to create the best delivery experience possible. Product focused Engineers work at the intersection of product and infrastructure to solve key business problems with elegant technical solutions. You’ll work with both technical and business teams to build features that keep our users top of mind.

This role is hybrid with some in-office time expected and will report to an Engineering Manager.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Become a product owner for one of our client facing applications.
  • Write robust, highly tested, well-crafted code that you can be proud of.

description:
Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

  1. diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;
  2. realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;
  3. avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;
  4. programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;
  5. ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde;
  6. realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.

Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina

Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe/ Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista.

Especialista em Traumatologia ou Urgência e Emergência em Oftalmologia, com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Traumatologia ou Urgência e Emergência ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
EF Corporate Learning is the world’s first and largest corporate language training provider. Delivering language training for organizations since 1965 and with 20+ million learners trained online since 1996, our legacy and global scale are unmatched. Many of the 3,000+ multinational organizations we serve have partnered with us for over 15 years.

Our award-winning method is designed using the largest dataset of language learners in the world, drawing from 2.2+ million English assessments, 5+ million live private classes yearly, and countless more learners enjoying structured self-study every day. The result is a learning experience with 3x better engagement and learning progress, helping your teams find their voice, faster.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Customer Success Manger (CSM) to work with training managers at some of the largest companies internationally and in Brazil– helping them to advance their global strategic objectives by improving their employees' intercultural communication and language skills.

As a successful CSM, you will be a highly organized, customer-driven client manager, who can uncover the stories behind the data and deliver excellence in the form of language training programs for employees. In the process, you will help our clients unlock the benefits of having English language fluency as a strategic asset for their global success.

In this role, your day-to-day work will vary tremendously – enabling you to serve as a consultant, project manager, change manager, analyst, internal communication specialist and in many more capacities. More broadly, you will play a vital role in our wider organization and in your local team, as you will be responsible for the delivery and success of our projects in your assigned territory.

What will your goals be?

  • Become quickly recognised by your customers as a trusted advisor and consultant who can help them reach their business goals through strategic investments in English language learning programmes, achieving clear KPIs, such as client satisfaction (Net Promoter Score) and renewal rates
  • Be recognised and celebrated by our global organisation for delivering your commitments and exceeding expectations in terms of client service
How will we help you succeed?
  • We offer premium cutting-edge educational products that you can implement with confidence.
  • We have a well-designed operational structure, so you can define your client needs and serve customers effectively
  • You will be able to proactively collaborate with other internal stakeholders to help you drive the implementation process forward – working closely with your local colleagues in Sales and Marketing, and with your colleagues on other teams elsewhere in Latin America and across Europe and, the US, the Middle East, and Asia
Who will succeed in this role?

Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

About the role

Digibee is looking to hire experienced and motivated Cloud Engineers with cloud computing and Kubernetes expertise. As a Cloud Engineer responsible for all the platform stack, you will modernize, maintain, and implement our Platform features.

On a typical day, you will…

  • Design, implement, and manage all the Kubernetes clusters of our SaaS Cloud Platform.

  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior cloud engineers and DevOps team members.

What you’ll need to bring…

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

It's a plus if you have…

  • Relevant certifications in Kubernetes and cloud platforms, such as CKA, CKAD, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or Azure DevOps Engineer Expert

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools, such as GitLab CI, FluxCD

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As an Implementations Project Manager, you will focus efforts on supporting new Investor Services customers in their journey into Carta services. You will drive operational excellence within our fast-growing Investor Services business by coordinating, facilitating and managing on-boarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline.

  • Support new Fund Administration, Portfolio Insights, and Valuations' clients by on-boarding them onto Carta – i.e., implementation of client’s limited partners list, investments, capitalization table and securities
  • Extract relevant information from operating agreements and subscription documents to upload limited partners to Carta
  • Analyze data thoroughly and precisely to maintain data integrity throughout the on-boarding process
  • Effectively liaise between sales and Investor Services teams as the bridge post-sales through implementation
  • Coordinate and manage multiple/simultaneous implementation projects by continually communicating with and motivating clients
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on-boarding process
  • Work closely with product and engineering to improve the on-boarding experience for customers

The Impact You’ll Have

You’ll play a critical role in the transformation of the financial services industry through partnering with our new clients and helping them implement our software. In this role you will be responsible for interacting with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate data to both the client and internal stakeholders.

About You

From sale close, to implementation, and continued customer success, the ideal Implementations Project Manager will exhibit excellent communication skills, a high degree of problem-solving, velocity, embracing change and will constantly seek ways to better their process to provide customers with a world-class on-boarding experience.

A disability is a condition that substantially limits one or more of your “major life activities.” If you have or have ever had such a condition, you are a person with a disability. Disabilities include, but are not limited to:

title: ESPECIALISTA CPCM CONFORMIDADE NORMATIVA
description:
Job description

Garantir a conformidade legal e regulatória das atividades de manutenção, assegurando que os procedimentos, práticas e documentações estejam alinhados às Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs), normas técnicas e requisitos de segurança, qualidade e meio ambiente, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro, prevenindo riscos operacionais e garantindo a continuidade das operações com excelência e aderência às exigências legais.


Main responsibilities

1. Gestão e Implementação das Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs)

Interpretar e aplicar as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e demais legislações aplicáveis à manutenção industrial, garantindo conformidade e segurança.

Implementar e monitorar a aplicação das normas em conjunto com as áreas de Segurança, Qualidade e Manutenção, assegurando adequação aos requisitos legais.

Assegurar que as práticas de manutenção estejam alinhadas às exigências de órgãos reguladores, como MTE, ANP e INMETRO, reduzindo riscos de não conformidade.

2. Auditorias, Inspeções e Conformidade Regulatória

Realizar auditorias internas e inspeções periódicas para avaliar a conformidade das operações com as normas aplicáveis.

Preparar e acompanhar auditorias externas de certificação e fiscalização, garantindo alinhamento com exigências legais.

Elaborar planos de ação para correção de não conformidades identificadas, promovendo melhorias contínuas nos processos de manutenção.

3. Desenvolvimento e Revisão de Procedimentos

Desenvolver, revisar e atualizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs) e instruções de trabalho conforme as normas vigentes.

Assegurar que os procedimentos atendam aos requisitos das normas de segurança e meio ambiente, como NR-10 (Segurança em Eletricidade), NR-12 (Máquinas e Equipamentos), NR-13 (Caldeiras e Vasos de Pressão) e demais exigências normativas.

Implementar metodologias de gestão documental para garantir fácil acesso e rastreabilidade dos procedimentos.

4. Treinamento e Capacitação

Elaborar e ministrar treinamentos técnicos e obrigatórios sobre normas regulamentadoras para equipes de manutenção.

Garantir que os colaboradores possuam capacitação e certificação conforme exigências legais, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho seguro e alinhado às melhores práticas.

Desenvolver programas de conscientização sobre segurança, integrando boas práticas ao dia a dia operacional.

5. Gestão de Documentação Técnica e Licenciamentos

Gerenciar e manter atualizada a documentação técnica obrigatória, incluindo laudos, certificados, prontuários e registros exigidos pelas normas regulamentadoras.

Controlar prazos e garantir a renovação de licenças e certificações de equipamentos críticos, evitando impactos nas operações.

Assegurar que toda a documentação esteja acessível para auditorias e inspeções, garantindo transparência e rastreabilidade.

6. Suporte Técnico e Assessoria

Assessorar gerentes, engenheiros e supervisores de manutenção na interpretação e aplicação das normas regulamentadoras, garantindo conformidade e segurança operacional.

Analisar projetos de manutenção e engenharia para assegurar que estejam alinhados às normas vigentes e aos requisitos legais.

Sugerir melhorias em processos, infraestrutura e equipamentos para mitigar riscos regulatórios e aumentar a eficiência operacional.

7. Interface com Órgãos Reguladores

Representar a empresa em auditorias, fiscalizações e inspeções conduzidas por órgãos reguladores, assegurando atendimento aos requisitos legais.

Estabelecer e manter comunicação com fornecedores, certificadoras e empresas terceirizadas, garantindo que os serviços prestados estejam em conformidade com as normas regulamentadoras.

Atuar na gestão de documentações e requisitos legais exigidos para certificações e inspeções periódicas, assegurando conformidade contínua.

8. Outras Responsabilidades

Executar as atividades da função respeitando todas as normas e procedimentos de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente, utilizando constantemente os EPIs obrigatórios e reportando situações de risco.

Exercer as atividades em conformidade com os valores, políticas, diretrizes e procedimentos da empresa, mantendo o foco nas metas organizacionais e protegendo informações confidenciais.

Manter a organização e a disciplina no ambiente de trabalho, aplicando os princípios do programa 5S.

Zelar pelos ativos e propriedades sob sua responsabilidade, informando problemas ou avarias detectadas ao superior imediato.


Requirements and skills

Ensino superior completo;

Pós-graduação completa;

Experiência profissional na área.


Additional information

Benefícios: Vale alimentação; Plano de saúde (Unimed); Plano odontológico; Vale transporte; Gympass; Refeição na empresa; Edupass.

description:
Nubank was founded in 2013 to free people from a bureaucratic, slow, and inefficient financial system. Since then, the company has been redefining people's relationships with money across Latin America through innovative technology and outstanding customer service. Today, Nubank is a global company with offices in São Paulo (Brazil), Mexico City (Mexico), Bogotá (Colombia), Durham (United States), and Berlin (Germany). The challenge of our Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team is to help Nubank make better financial decisions. We are looking for someone who:

• Has experience in financial analysis (P&L, Balance Sheet), credit analysis, or related areas;
• Has strong analytical skills to manage and evaluate complex data;
• Possesses strong communication skills to proactively engage with different business partners and stakeholders (Product, Finance, Markets);
• Has advanced knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets;
• Is fluent in English;
• Programming knowledge (Scala, SQL, and Python) is a plus.

title: Analista de Riscos
description:
Sobre nós

O Grupo Swile é um grupo multinacional francês pioneiro em benefícios flexíveis no Brasil. A nossa missão é ajudar a oferecer um melhor ambiente de trabalho para os seus colaboradores através dos benefícios flexíveis Swile que entregamos por meio de uma tecnologia de ponta.

Temos no grupo uma Instituição de Pagamento recém autorizada a funcionar pelo Banco Central do Brasil, e estamos em busca de novos integrantes para nosso time de Compliance, Controles Internos e Riscos.

Sobre a posição

  1. Criar métricas de avaliação de risco, incluindo baixo, médio e alto, partindo do zero;
  2. Gestão contínua do capital (controle de segundo nível);
  3. Monitorar os ativos ponderados pelo risco (RWA) e o Capital Regulatório (PR) (controle de segundo nível);
  4. Submeter documentos de risco ao Bacen;
  5. Criar a Declaração de Apetite ao Risco (RAS);
  6. Identificar, medir, avaliar, monitorar, reportar, controlar e mitigar riscos de crédito, operacionais, de liquidez, sociais, ambientais e climáticos;
  7. Criar políticas para rotinas da área, partindo do zero;
  8. Avaliar a criação de novos produtos ou serviços, bem como alterações ou manutenção dos produtos existentes;
  9. Criar testes de estresse;
  10. Elaborar um relatório anual sobre Riscos, inclusive operacional, a ser divulgado a Diretoria, Auditoria Interna e Externa;
  11. Elaborar o relatório do Pilar 3, incluindo a publicação no site;
  12. Criar o plano de continuidade de negócios com a equipe de Tecnologia e Produtos.

Requisitos

  1. Formação superior em Administração, Direito, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Inglês avançado;
  3. Experiência prévia de, no mínimo, 6 anos na área de Riscos, necessariamente em empresas reguladas pelo Banco Central do Brasil;
  4. Conhecimento das normas e regulamentações sobre Riscos do Banco Central do Brasil;

O que esperamos de você

  1. Capacidade de análise crítica, organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  2. Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes áreas da empresa e com órgãos reguladores;
  3. Boa comunicação e habilidade para elaboração de relatórios e apresentações;
  4. Proatividade na identificação e solução de problemas relacionados aos Riscos identificados;
  5. Capacidade de adaptar-se rapidamente a mudanças regulatórias e operacionais;
  6. Engajamento para criar e fortalecer de Riscos numa Instituição de Pagamento que acaba de ser criada;
  7. Conexão com o propósito da Swile - ao se aplicar, entenda mais sobre nosso propósito e se ele conversa com o seu.

Sobre nossos valores

  1. We are team players: nós nos importamos com nossos colegas e navegamos bem entre áreas;
  2. We are doers: temos ano nível de autonomia e entregamos resultados tangíveis;
  3. We move fast: identificamos corretamente as prioridades e assumimos a iniciativa;
  4. We are ambassadors: entendemos sobre o mercado, o produto e estamos alinhados em torno da mesma visão;
  5. We stay hungry: somos resilientes e gostamos de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento;
  6. We cherish our values: abrimos mão do ego e aceitamos feedbacks como um presente.

O que oferecemos

  1. Pacote de benefícios flexíveis super atraentes para você usar como quiser (flexfood, mobilidade, cultura, educação, etc) dentro do cartão Swile;
  2. Remuneração variável;
  3. ️Plano de Saúde, Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  4. TotalPass (acesso às melhores academias e estúdios);
  5. Saúde emocional (sessões de terapia gratuitas com um de nossos parceiros);
  6. Swile Shop (desconto em mais de 1.100 lojas e restaurantes);
  7. ️Aulas de inglês ou francês;
  8. Auxílio farmácia;
  9. Day off de aniversário;
  10. Auxílio Home-office;
  11. Auxílio Creche.

Nós abraçamos e incentivamos a diversidade e inclusão no nosso time, então, sinta-se livre para ser quem você é junto à nós.

O C6 Bank está comprometido com a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, valorizando a diversidade e promovendo a equidade dentro dos nossos times. Como parte dessa estratégia, buscamos aumentar a representatividade de pessoas com deficiência em nossas contratações, incluindo vagas especialmente direcionadas a esse grupo. Essa ação está alinhada aos nossos compromissos como empresa em ampliar cada vez mais a diversidade dos nossos times e fortalecer nossa cultura inclusiva.

Essa vaga é afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência.

Sobre o Programa Diversifica

O Diversifica é um programa afirmativo de desenvolvimento profissional voltado para a formação técnica de Pessoas com Deficiência , com o objetivo de capacitá-las para atuar nas áreas de negócios, corporativas ou de operações do C6 Bank .

O processo seletivo ocorre em duas etapas: a primeira consiste em uma dinâmica de grupo, e a segunda, em uma entrevista individual com o time de Talent Acquisition e a liderança da área.

Após a contratação, os participantes passarão por um treinamento de dois meses em Lógica de Programação e Banco de Dados , oferecido pelo C6 Bank ministrado pelo IOS com o objetivo de fornecer habilidades técnicas essenciais. Ao final da formação, os participantes serão alocados nas áreas de negócios, corporativas e de operações do C6 Bank, aplicando os conhecimentos adquiridos.

  • Colaborar com a equipe para otimizar processos e sistemas internos, identificando pontos de melhoria e propondo soluções.

Requisitos e experiência

  • Vontade de aprofundar conhecimentos técnicos, com foco em manipulação e análise de dados para apoiar as áreas de negócios e corporativas;
  • Interesse em crescer e evoluir profissionalmente, com foco no desenvolvimento de carreira a longo prazo;
  • Desejável: Graduação ou tecnólogo em andamento ou concluída em Administração, Tecnologia, Gestão de Negócios, Ciências Econômicas, Ciências Contábeis, Sistemas da Informação ou cursos correlatos;

  • Empresa Cidadã - Prorrogação do prazo da licença-maternidade e licença-paternidade;
  • Espaço de convivência - Videogame, mesa de sinuca, playball, churrasqueira, chopeira, lanchonete, diversos locais de descanso, redes, cesta de basquete e horta colaborativa e orgânica.

Atendemos pessoas físicas, MEIs e PMEs em todos os estados do Brasil. Sem agências físicas para te prender, oferecemos mais de 90 produtos e serviços financeiros feitos para todos os perfis de clientes. Summary:
This Senior Credit Manager – Special Projects position is a highly strategic role responsible for leading and executing complex credit-related initiatives within the organization. The incumbent will provide expert credit analysis and risk assessment for Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A), oversee credit management for Joint Venture partnerships, manage the credit application process of the company’s financial statement analysis application, and contribute to other special projects as needed. This role requires deep expertise in credit management, a strong understanding of Brazilian agribusiness, excellent leadership skills, and the ability to effectively collaborate with senior management.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Mergers & Acquisitions:
    • Conduct comprehensive due diligence and credit analysis on target companies.
    • Identify and quantify key credit risks and opportunities and participate in the structuring of credit solutions in M&A transactions.
    • Develop and present credit risk assessments and recommendations to senior management.
    • Support the integration of acquired companies into existing credit processes.
  • Joint Venture Partnerships:
    • Provide guidance for credit analysis and risk management practices for joint venture partnerships.
    • Develop and implement credit policies and procedures for joint ventures.
    • Monitor the credit performance of joint venture partners.
    • Provide guidance and training to joint venture partners on credit-related matters.
  • Financial Statement Analysis Application:
    • Manage the credit application process associated with the company’s financial statement analysis application.
    • Ensure the application effectively captures and analyzes relevant credit data.
    • Monitor the application’s performance and identify areas for improvement.
    • Collaborate with IT and other stakeholders on application development and maintenance.
  • Special Projects:
    • Contribute credit expertise to various special projects as they arise.
    • Provide credit risk assessments and recommendations for strategic initiatives.
    • Support the development and implementation of new credit products and services.
  • Leadership and Collaboration:
    • Interact effectively with executive-level managers, providing clear and concise credit information.
    • Collaborate with other leaders across commercial, finance, legal, and other departments.
    • Lead and mentor credit team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing team environment.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. MBA preferred.
  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in credit management, including experience with M&A, joint ventures, and credit application processes.
  • Thorough understanding of the agricultural business and associated credit risks in Brazil.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills, including the ability to manage, motivate, and mentor teams.
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills. Proficiency in both Portuguese and English languages.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

title: AI Sales Engineer
description:
Role Overview

You’re the technical linchpin between our sales team and clients. As a GenAI Sales Architect, you’ll support discovery and solution-fit calls, shape compelling proposals, and ensure our GenAI offerings—across text, vision, and audio—align perfectly with client needs. Your deep expertise in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI, and function-calling architectures will turn opportunities into robust, future-proof solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pre-Sales Support : Participate in client workshops and sales calls to uncover requirements, map business problems to GenAI use cases, and recommend architectures.

  • Solution Design: Architect end-to-end GenAI proposals leveraging:

    • RAG Pipelines: Embedding strategies, vector stores, dynamic retrieval flows.

    • Agentic AI: Multi-agent orchestration for workflows, tool use and function calling.

    • Function-Calling: Designing safe, scalable function-execution patterns (e.g., retrieval, data enrichment, custom tool integrations).

    • Multimodal Components: Text generation & summarization, vision pipelines (OCR, image analysis), and audio services (speech-to-text, TTS, voice bots).

  • Proposal Development: Draft Statements of Work, high-level architecture diagrams, effort estimates, and risk/mitigation plans in collaboration with sales leadership.

  • Technical Evangelism: Deliver live demos and proof-of-concepts; distill complex AI concepts into clear, persuasive narratives for C-level and technical audiences.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work alongside global industry leaders to deliver and validate solution architectures, ensuring alignment with best practices and compliance standards.

  • Model Governance Advice: Recommend approaches for fine-tuning, bias mitigation, performance monitoring, and MLOps integration in client environments.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 2+ years in a pre-sales, solutions architect, or technical consulting role focused on generative AI.

  • Proven track record designing and pitching RAG-driven applications and agentic AI workflows.

  • Hands-on with function-calling patterns in LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, or similar).

  • Strong Python skills and experience integrating LLMs into production pipelines.

  • Excellent English communication and presentation skills;

Bonus Skills

  • Experience integrating GenAI into enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, or SAP.
